# Projomia
> Free iPhone app that keeps project photos, plans, notes and daily logs in a local library, with optional AI using your own OpenAI connection. For site managers, engineers and contractors worldwide.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://projomia.com/): what Projomia does and how to get it
- [Support](https://projomia.com/support/): iPhone, Android early access and offline use
- [Privacy](https://projomia.com/privacy/): local records and optional AI
- [Try it](https://projomia.com/try.html): 30-second interactive example with fictional data
- [Morning site briefing example](https://projomia.com/briefing.html): what a morning briefing should answer, with an interactive fictional example
- [Construction delay example](https://projomia.com/decision-lab.html): three ways to respond to a late delivery, with fictional data
- [Offline construction app](https://projomia.com/offline-construction-app/): what works without signal, where records live
- [Construction daily report template](https://projomia.com/construction-daily-report-template/): what to include, free printable template
- [Construction daily log app](https://projomia.com/construction-daily-log-app/): Daily Log as a site diary on iPhone
- [Construction photo documentation app](https://projomia.com/construction-photo-documentation-app/): how to document site progress with photos
- [Construction site inspection checklist](https://projomia.com/construction-inspection-checklist-template/): free printable checklist, checklists by location
- [Offline construction photo apps for iPhone, compared](https://projomia.com/best-offline-construction-photo-apps-iphone/): vendor-stated facts, checked 27 Nov 2026
- [Free CompanyCam alternative](https://projomia.com/companycam-alternative/): factual comparison, checked 27 Nov 2026
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/projomia/id6833906753): download for iPhone

## Availability
- iPhone: free on the App Store (iOS 18 or later). No subscription, ads or tracking.
- Android: early access by request — email support@projomia.com with your Google Play email. No AI on Android.
- Mac: not yet available.

## Facts
- Records stay in a local library on the device. No Projomia account or server in this release.
- Capture, notes, documents, Planner, Journal and Daily Log work offline.
- AI is optional: connect your own OpenAI API key or ChatGPT sign-in. AI replies stay "unverified" until you confirm them.
